Outside OPR HR of Uzhhorod TWR the airspace TMA Uzhhorod WEST: - is declared as the corresponding part of the airspace LZR55, - above 8 000 ft AMSL the airspace classification changes from D to C and - in the rest part the airspace classification changes from D to G. SAR provided by appropriate authorities of the Slovak Republic. Aircraft flying in the airspace of the Slovak Republic can enter into the TMA Uzhhorod WEST without crossing the external state border with Ukraine after obtaining ATC clearance from Uzhhorod TWR. Submission of a flight plan using limited information of a flight plan may be used for domestic flights penetrating TMA Uzhhorod WEST (see para. ENR 1.10.1.1.5).
